list.searchPlaceholder: Search by service, account or tag

empty.title: No codes yet
empty.description: Your two-step verification codes show up here. Turn on two-step verification in the service you want to protect and add the QR code it shows you.

addSheet.title: Add code
addSheet.scanHint: With the camera or from a screenshot
addSheet.manualHint: By hand or by pasting an otpauth:// link

row.copyHidden: {name}. Code hidden. Press to show and copy it.

fields.accountOptional: Optional. Helps you tell apart several accounts of the same service.
fields.secretHint: The service shows it next to the QR code, sometimes as “setup key”. You can paste it with spaces.
fields.periodHint: How often the code changes, in seconds. Almost always 30.
fields.counterHint: The number of the next code. Unless the service says otherwise, leave it at 0.
fields.tagsHint: Press Enter or type a comma to add one.
fields.notesPlaceholder: Where the backup codes are kept, what this account is for…
fields.pinned: Pin to the top of the list
fields.advancedHint: Only if the service gives you other values. The defaults work for almost all of them.
fields.steamFixed: Steam Guard always uses 5-character codes that change every 30 seconds.

validation.required: Enter the name of the service or of the account.
validation.secretEmpty: Enter the secret key the service gives you.
validation.secretCharacters: The key only has letters A to Z and numbers 2 to 7. Check for a 0, 1, 8 or 9: they are usually an O, an I or a B.
validation.secretShort: The key is missing characters. Copy all of it.
validation.period: Enter a number of seconds between 1 and 86,400.
validation.counter: Enter a whole number, 0 or more.

uriErrors.invalid_uri: That is not an authenticator link. It must start with otpauth://
uriErrors.unsupported_type: This link is for a type of code AccioPass does not support.
uriErrors.missing_secret: The link has no secret key. Copy all of it or enter the key by hand.
uriErrors.invalid_secret: The secret key in the link is not valid. Copy it again or enter the key by hand.
uriErrors.unsupported_algorithm: The link asks for an algorithm AccioPass does not support. SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 work.
uriErrors.invalid_digits: The link asks for codes of a length we do not support. 6 to 8 digits work.
uriErrors.invalid_period: The period in the link is not valid.
uriErrors.invalid_counter: The counter in the link is not valid.
uriErrors.invalid_time: The code could not be calculated with this device’s clock. Check the date and time.
uriErrors.invalid_migration: We could not read the Google Authenticator export. Generate the QR code again and retry.

new.title: Add code
new.modeLabel: How you want to add it
new.uriHint: Paste the link that starts with otpauth://. Some sites offer it as “I can’t scan the code”.
new.understoodHint: Check it is the account you want to add before saving.
new.fromScan: We read the QR code. Review the details and save.
new.filledFromUri: We filled in the details from the link you pasted.
new.steamTitle: This looks like a Steam code
new.steamGuess: The link says Steam and 5-digit codes, which is how some apps export Steam Guard. If you save it, it is added as a Steam code, with 5 characters.
new.bulk: You pasted several links or a Google Authenticator export. Open them in Import to choose which ones to add.
new.offline: You are offline. The code is saved on this device and will sync when the connection is back.
new.discardMessage: What you typed will be lost.

preview.title: Current code
preview.hint: If the service asks for a code to finish setting up, this is it. Check that it is accepted.
preview.counterHint: This is the code for counter {counter}.
preview.waiting: It will appear here as soon as the key is complete.

scan.title: Scan QR
scan.intro: Point at the QR code the service shows when you turn on two-step verification.
scan.permission: AccioPass uses the camera only to read the QR code. The image is analysed on this device and is never stored or sent anywhere.
scan.deniedWeb: The browser has blocked the camera. Allow it from the padlock icon next to the page address and try again. You can also upload an image of the QR code.
scan.deniedNative: AccioPass is not allowed to use the camera. Allow it in the device settings or choose an image of the QR code.
scan.unavailable: We found no camera on this device. Upload an image of the QR code or enter the key by hand.
scan.insecure: The browser only allows the camera on secure pages (https). Upload an image of the QR code or enter the key by hand.
scan.busy: Another application may be using it. Close it and try again, or upload an image of the QR code.
scan.viewfinder: Camera image. Place the QR code inside the frame.
scan.uploadHint: A screenshot or a photo of the QR code.
scan.drop: or drag an image of the QR code here
scan.dropActive: Drop the image to read the QR code
scan.noQr: No QR code can be made out in that image. Try a sharper screenshot that shows the whole code.
scan.notImage: That file is not an image. Choose a screenshot or a photo of the QR code.
scan.notOtpTitle: That QR code is not from an authenticator
scan.notOtp: We read it, but it holds no account to generate codes for. Look for the QR code the service shows when you turn on two-step verification.
scan.unreadableTitle: We cannot use this QR code
scan.offline: Scanning works offline: the code is saved on this device and synced later.

import.title: Import codes
import.intro: Bring your codes from another app. The plain-text export of Ente Auth, Aegis, 2FAS and others works (one otpauth:// link per line), and so does the “Transfer accounts” QR code of Google Authenticator.
import.chooseFileHint: A text file (.txt) with one link per line.
import.pasteHint: What you paste is read at once and does not stay on screen.
import.fileTooLarge: That file is too large to be an export of codes. Choose the text file the other app produced.
import.fileUnreadable: We could not read that file. Check that it is the text file of the export.
import.nothingFound: There is no authenticator link in there. Each line must start with otpauth://
import.encryptedHint: If the other app exported an encrypted file, export again as plain text: AccioPass cannot open its encrypted backups.

duplicatesNote.one: {count} code is already in your vault or appears twice. It was left unselected.
duplicatesNote.other: {count} codes are already in your vault or appear twice. They were left unselected.

import.steamNote: It came as a 5-digit TOTP with Steam as issuer: we read it as a Steam Guard code.
import.counterHint: Google Authenticator does not say whether this number belongs to the last code used or to the next one. If the code does not work after importing, press “Next code” once.

skipped.one: {count} account in the export uses a format AccioPass does not support and cannot be imported.
skipped.other: {count} accounts in the export use a format AccioPass does not support and cannot be imported.

missingParts.one: The Google Authenticator export is split over several QR codes: {count} is still to be scanned.
missingParts.other: The Google Authenticator export is split over several QR codes: {count} are still to be scanned.

import.truncated: The text is very long: we only read the first {count} lines.
import.partial: {added} of {total} were imported. The rest could not be saved.
import.offline: You are offline. The codes are saved on this device and will sync when the connection is back.

export.title: Export codes
export.warning: It holds the secret keys of all your codes in plain text. Anyone who opens it can generate your codes. Keep it somewhere safe and delete it when you no longer need it.

what.one: {count} code will be exported as an otpauth:// link, a format Ente Auth, Aegis, 2FAS and other apps understand.
what.other: {count} codes will be exported as otpauth:// links, a format Ente Auth, Aegis, 2FAS and other apps understand.

export.notIncluded: Tags, notes and the order are not part of that format and are not exported.
export.sharedIncluded: It includes the codes other people share with you.
export.confirm: I understand the file is not encrypted
export.failed: The file could not be created. Try again.
export.empty: There are no codes to export.

detail.notFound: You may have deleted it from another device.
detail.copyHint: Press the code to copy it.
detail.secretHint: Every code of this account is generated from it: whoever has it can generate them too.
detail.transfer: Show a QR code to add this account in another app or device. It holds the secret key: anyone who sees or photographs it can generate your codes.
detail.transferHotp: The QR code carries the current counter. If you use this account in two places at once, the counters will drift apart.
detail.qrLabel: QR code with the key of {name}
detail.qrAutoHide: It will hide itself in a minute.
detail.qrUnavailable: The QR code cannot be generated because the stored key is not valid.
detail.pending: Waiting to sync. It is saved on this device and will be sent when there is a connection.
detail.sharingPrivate: Only you have this code. You can share it with other AccioPass users: they will see the same codes as you in their list.
detail.sharedByYouNone: You share it, but nobody has accepted yet.
detail.roleViewer: You can see and copy the code, but not change it.
detail.roleEditor: You can edit it. Changes reach everyone who shares it.
detail.roleOwner: You are the one sharing it. Changes reach everyone.
detail.deleteMessage: You will stop generating codes for this account on all your devices. First turn off two-step verification in the service, or make sure you have another way in.
detail.deleteSharedMessage: It will be deleted for you and for everyone you share it with. First make sure you all have another way into the account.
detail.deleteOffline: Deleting a shared code needs a connection.
detail.leaveMessage: It will disappear from your devices. Whoever shares it keeps it and can invite you again.
detail.left: You no longer receive the {name} code
detail.leaveOffline: Leaving a shared code needs a connection.
detail.noChanges: There are no changes to save
detail.secretChangeTitle: You changed details that affect the code
detail.secretChange: If the key, the type, the algorithm, the digits or the period are not the ones the service gave, the codes will stop working.
